headline: Curiosity rover finds new rock textures on Mars
standfirst: NASA's Mars rover just encountered a sudden change in the planet's geology.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The Curiosity rover unexpectedly found rocks with a new texture this week.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The rover had been exploring smooth, layered bedrock in a sulfate-rich area.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Unexpected geological shifts can reveal new details about the history of Mars.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Scientists are currently planning the next steps for the rover as of September 18.

caption:
NASA Curiosity rover scientists report a surprising change in rock texture on Mars.

The team at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center noted the shift while exploring a sulfate unit. This unexpected discovery marks a departure from the finely layered bedrock blocks Curiosity has been studying recently.
